entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a separated two-tree game sprite sheet, EXACTLY TWO full-height isolated trees in equal left and right columns on genuine transparency. Use the two supplied gameplay screenshots ONLY as art-direction references for SIMPLE hand-drawn dark ink outlines, flat cel-color masses, restrained detail and cave-forest palette. LEFT TREE: original ancient broadleaf tree with a thick slightly bent trunk, a few graphic angular branches and a compact dark irregular leaf canopy. RIGHT TREE: original dark fir with a strong trunk and three angular loosely triangular canopy tiers. Both have grounded short roots. Make silhouettes distinct, readable and elegant. NOT realistic, NOT pixel art, NOT painterly dense foliage; use large flat blue-gray and charcoal teal shapes, a few subdued desaturated bark-brown shapes, bold nearly black outer contour lines and just a few meaningful interior branch/bark lines. Like a premium hand-inked survival game environment prop. Low-oblique 3/4 game view with upright trees. Cool neutral soft illumination, retain readable fills so actual game lighting can darken them. Full tree and roots in each own column with ample transparent padding and a wide empty gap between columns. All pixels outside each tree genuinely transparent, no halo, no scenery, no ground tile, no shadows beyond roots, no grass, no fungi, no UI, no words, no text. Do not copy characters, icons, symbols, objects or tree shapes from screenshots; make new original trees in their broad visual language. Keep tree detail SPARSE and LINEAR.
entries.processing: Split into independent transparent tree files as requested.
